PW-1.after: A Current Password box; wrong guesses count toward the normal login lockout.
PW-1.group: Picker, My Aircraft, Admin, My Account

PW-2.title: No readable copy of a password you chose
PW-2.before: When someone changes their own password the system still saved a readable copy an admin could see.
PW-2.after: Nothing readable is saved for self-chosen or reset passwords. Admin-set starting passwords can still be shown (that is how they are sent).
PW-2.group: Picker, My Aircraft, Admin, My Account

PW-3.title: Forgot password by email
PW-3.before: Login page says to ask an admin to reset it.
PW-3.after: A Forgot your password? link: type username or email, get a one-hour, one-use link, choose a new one. Same answer on screen whether or not the account exists.
PW-3.group: Picker, My Aircraft, Admin, My Account

UI-1.title: Back button is just the arrow
UI-1.before: The back button showed an arrow and the word Back on wider screens.

FLY-30.title: Dashboard shortcuts match each person's most frequent jobs
FLY-30.before: Instructors got Log a Past Session, Schedule, Students, Planes; students got Request a Flight and Schedule.
FLY-30.after: Instructors: Schedule, Availability, Waitlist, Students. Students: Request a Flight, Schedule, Availability, Waitlist (no planes). Log a Past Session moves to the Schedule form switch and Flight History.

UI-2.title: Tighter spacing at half-screen laptop width
UI-2.before: At about 700px wide (a laptop window snapped to half) the pages use phone-sized padding and gaps, so less fits on screen.
UI-2.after: Smaller page padding, card padding, form gaps, table cell padding and button height between 576 and 1099px wide. Phones and full desktop are unchanged.
